# Irha Apparels

> OEM, ODM and private-label apparel manufacturer based in Sialkot, Pakistan — Bavarian & trachten, premium leather, sportswear, streetwear & activewear, and leisure & nightwear, exported worldwide.

Irha Apparels is a B2B apparel manufacturer producing garments for brands, retailers and sourcing teams across the USA, EU, UK, UAE and beyond. In-house cutting, stitching, embroidery, sublimation, leather work and sampling studio. MOQ, sample availability, cost and lead times are confirmed after requirement review — nothing is fixed until a specification is agreed.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Irha Apparels — categories, capabilities and how to start an order.
- [About](/about): Company story, Sialkot atelier and values.
- [Collections](/products): Five specialist apparel categories with sub-categories and downloadable catalogues.
- [Manufacturing](/manufacturing): Production capacity, machinery and quality-control workflow.
- [Sustainability](/sustainability): Materials, recycled inputs and ethical practices. Third-party certifications are confirmed per program.
- [Journal](/journal): Editorial articles on craft, sourcing and the apparel industry.
- [FAQ](/faq): Sampling, customization, shipping, payment terms and QC.
- [Inquiry](/inquiry): Unified B2B inquiry — quotes, samples, catalogues, tech-pack uploads and meeting requests.
- [Studio](/studio): Non-binding AI mockup concept preview for requirement discussion.
- [Contact](/contact): Email, WhatsApp and Sialkot atelier address.
